plugin.name: Bodycam item (battery powered)
plugin.description: Adds battery-powered Axon Body cameras in five generations: Body 1 is the worst, Body 5 the best (picture quality and features such as GPS, night mode and identification). Body 1 is sold by traders for 5,000 and given on a new game; Body 2 to 5 are crafted, each from the one before, behind the electronics recipe books. The bodycam effect only runs while you carry a charged camera anywhere in your inventory; it drains in real time and takes standard batteries (drag a battery onto it). Battery life and camera generations are set in MCM (Zone Bodycam: Item). The REC timer keeps counting while the camera is off. On by default; untick to keep the bodycam always on.

plugin.name: Standard icons (1x1)
plugin.description: The Axon Body cameras take a single 1x1 cell in the inventory, with standard-resolution icons. Works everywhere (default).

plugin.name: HD icons (HD Inventory Icons Framework)
plugin.description: Sharper icons at twice the resolution, still in a single 1x1 cell. Needs HD Inventory Icons Framework (part of GAMMA) and modded exes (DLTX). Without the framework the cameras take 2x2 cells instead.
